banners.prompt:
Create a photorealistic product mockup of a printed paperback book standing slightly angled, turned a little to the LEFT so that we see the front cover and the white page edges on the RIGHT side of the book. The spine is NOT visible: no spine, no back cover and no text anywhere except the front cover. Physically correct perspective like a real product photo on a pure white background, soft natural shadow under it. The book fills about 75% of the frame height and is fully visible, nothing cropped.
FRONT COVER DESIGN - "puppy and big dog": bright clean background, soft light mint fading to white. In the middle of the cover a small playful beagle-like puppy with one paw raised sits next to a big calm golden labrador-like dog; both look at the viewer, photorealistic, soft studio light.
Title at the top in dark teal #0E3B43, the words "ЩАСТЛИВО" and "ЩАСТЛИВ" in warm orange #F28C28. Under the dogs the letters "L.E.A.S.H." are large in dark teal with a small orange dog paw print under each letter. Subtitle below in dark teal. Orange round badge with dark text in the top-left corner. Bottom: a dark teal strip with four simple white line icons (leash, chewed shoe, speech bubble with sound waves, house) - icons only, no text.
TEXT ON THE COVER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Title line 1: "ЩАСТЛИВО КУЧЕ,"
2) Title line 2: "ЩАСТЛИВ СТОПАНИН"
3) Subtitle, smaller, 3-4 lines: "Научи как с лесната система L.E.A.S.H. за кученца и възрастни кучета, да спреш дърпането на каишката, лаенето, изгризаните обувки и „изненадите“ вкъщи."
4) Round badge, 3 short lines: "ПРАКТИЧНО" / "ЛЕСНО" / "ПОЛЕЗНО"
5) The large letters under the dogs: "L.E.A.S.H."

TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic except "L.E.A.S.H.". Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation and quotation marks. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Heavy, clean sans-serif with full Cyrillic (Montserrat ExtraBold / Black style) for titles; clean regular sans-serif for the subtitle. Large and clearly legible on a phone.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices, author names or website addresses anywhere.
DOGS: ordinary friendly family dogs like Bulgarians keep (mixed breed, beagle-like, labrador-like, small terrier), not exotic breeds; natural anatomy, four legs, correct eyes and paws. NO people anywhere, no faces; if a hand appears it is gender-neutral (no nail polish, no jewellery, no sleeve), five fingers.
STYLE: premium, warm, friendly, clean professional design like a bestselling publisher would use. Palette: dark teal #0E3B43, warm orange #F28C28, light mint #E3F4EE and white.
